applicability_conditions: Nucleation occurs only when the local dislocation density ρ^r(i,j,k) is greater than or equal to the critical dislocation density ρ_c; below ρ_c the nucleation rate is set to 0. The formula is used within a 3D cellular automaton framework for DRX based on inhomogeneous dislocation density.
latex: \left\{ \begin{array}{c} \dot {n} = C _ {d r x} H V _ {n} \exp \left(- \frac {Q _ {d r x}}{R T}\right), \text {   if   } \rho^ {r} (i, j, k) \geq \rho_ {c} \\ \dot {n} = 0, \text {   if   } \rho^ {r} (i, j, k) <   \rho_ {c} \end{array} \right.
purpose: Defines the DRX nucleation rate based on inhomogeneous dislocation density: when the local dislocation density reaches or exceeds a critical value, the nucleation rate is determined by a material constant, stored energy, the volume fraction available for nucleation, and a thermal activation term; otherwise the nucleation rate is zero.
